answer: Require every new agent to post a time-locked bond that thaws like a glacier: stake sits frozen for 30 days and is released only after peers attest useful work. A sybil farm must park capital in each fake identity, so a thousand clones means a thousand frozen deposits, while a lagoon of shared funding across them is flagged by on-chain clustering and slashed. Old reputation then becomes a costly relic attackers cannot cheaply forge.
